pr_body:
This PR adds a new `MetadataDeleteDataStreamService` to delete system data streams prior to a `restore` operation.

closes https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/89261
pr_title: Bug Fix: System Data Streams Should Be Restorable

review_comment: I don't understand this TODO entirely, why would we want to change the order when invoked by the delete index API?
Me neither, but it was already there in the transport action so I kept it.
Just commenting on this line so we don't forget this TODO. I don't know enough about (partial) snapshots to know if this is something we need to cover. @dakrone, any thoughts?
I'm not sure how we'd even set this up to test this.  Any ideas?

A partial snapshot would be one where some of the shards were snapshotted and others weren't. If we take a snapshot with `partial: true` while the index is red (say it had two primaries and one were unavailable) that would cause a partial snapshot.

It would probably be good to test this as well, since we test it for regular system indices.
